title: Cladone gateway injection bundle
description: Formal grammar of a route's injection bundle (the JSON file referenced by route.inject in api-routes.json). Complementary source of truth: gate-one-src/internal/core/routes.go. Loading is strict: unknown fields are rejected and a faulty bundle refuses startup/reload.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema (autocompletion and validation in the editor; ignored at runtime).

injects.description: HTML/JS/CSS insertions, sorted by increasing order within the same target.

patch.description: Attribute patch rules applied client-side by the guard on every evaluation cycle.

name.description: Unique identifier within the bundle (used in logs).

target.description: Named insertion target: head (default, after <head>/meta charset) or body-end (before </body>); an empty string means head.

order.description: Position within the same target (30+; the guard is 10, the PWA 20).

when.description: Path prefix of the pages to target (same grammar as route.path; absent = the whole site).

file.description: Path relative to the bundle (never absolute or containing '..'); read at load and injected as-is.

injectPatch.description: A patch rule. The listed attributes are added or its value updated on the matched elements (typically data-gtw-*), client-side, on every guard evaluation cycle (dynamic elements covered). Other attributes are left untouched; an existing attribute with the same exact name is updated.

selector.description: CSS selector (querySelectorAll); an invalid selector = rule ignored, nothing broken.

attrs.description: Exact attribute names to set and their string values (e.g. {"data-gtw-logout": "", "data-gtw-auth-hidden": "after"}). No wildcard or prefix matching; no attribute removal.
